/* OrderMapper.selectHblNoList */ SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;
SELECT od.HBL_NO ,od.HSN ,od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.CD_TYPE ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME ,od.CD_USE_TYPE ,od.INSPECTION_YN ,ad.SE_INSPECTION_YN FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{srchMasterOdJobNo}
AND ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO = #{simpleDocNo}
AND ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO IS NULL
AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'
AND ${srchNoType} IN (#{item})
AND ${srchNoType} = #{srchNo}
AND od.CD_TYPE = 'Y'
AND od.CD_TYPE = 'B'
AND od.CD_TYPE = 'N'
AND od.INSPECTION_YN = 'Y'
AND ad.SE_INSPECTION_YN = 'Y'
AND ad.XRAY_YN = 'Y'
AND ad.CRIME_SELECTION_YN = 'N'
AND ad.DROP_YN = 'Y'
AND EXISTS (SELECT OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND HOLD_RELEASE_YN = 'N')
AND EXISTS (SELECT OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO)
AND ISNULL(od.INSPECTION_TYPE,'') != '' AND ISNULL(od.INSPECTION_TYPE,'') NOT IN ('8','10')
AND od.INSPECTION_TYPE = '8'
AND od.INSPECTION_TYPE = '10'
AND od.CD_TYPE = 'Y'
AND od.CD_TYPE = 'N'
AND od.CD_TYPE = 'E'

,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT hod.OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD hod LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_HOLD hld ON hod.OD_JOB_NO = hld.OD_JOB_NO
